entities.summary: Sampson Ahi is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Bodi constituency in the Western region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress. He is the Deputy Minister-Designate for Trade, Agribusiness, and Industry.
